audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagreed with the packet chart (Poppy, Skill, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Skill, Skill) — and the packet agrees with every one of the page's own whys.
audit.why: whys[0] 'out-trade you' (Poppy, rendered Skill); whys[1] 'Still even-to-behind' (Skill, rendered Ornn); whys[2] 'trade back and neutralize her' (Skill, rendered Ornn); whys[4] 'Your R double knock-up wins the all-in' (Ornn, rendered Skill); whys[5] 'trades stay genuinely even' (Skill, rendered Ornn); whys[6] 'Neither out-itemizes the other' (Skill, rendered Ornn). At 49.76% over 840 games this is a genuine 50/50 lane and the chart was showing Ornn winning four rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Poppy, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Skill, Skill. Row 0 rating to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was generic and never named Steadfast Presence or Keeper's Verdict.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence coming online is the real spike in this lane — at 20s rank 1 falling to 12s maxed, its availability is what decides whether Searing Charge can be thrown at all.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Poppy — Steadfast Presence online, Keeper's Verdict at 6 (140s), first item. Ornn — level 3 for Bellows Breath, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2 items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (1) whys[0] and spikes[0] credit Poppy with a 'Q knockup' / 'knockup-tipped slam'. Hammer Shock has no knockup — Riot's text is 'deals damage and creates a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' (2) The single most important terrain interaction in this matchup was absent: Heroic Charge 'dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned' — and Ornn's own Volcanic Rupture pillar IS a wall. Dropping a pillar behind yourself hands Poppy the stun.
audit.why: Ornn is one of the only champions who can create the terrain his opponent needs to stun him. The page told the player to Q a pillar without ever warning them which side to put it on. Also never named: Iron Ambassador's buckler must be PICKED UP for the shield (deny the pickup, deny the shield), Steadfast Presence stops dashes around her and then slows AND grounds the victim, and Keeper's Verdict is a channel that any CC cancels.
audit.corrected: The knockup claim removed; pillar placement stated as front-only in four strings; Iron Ambassador's pickup, Steadfast Presence's stop-slow-ground and the Keeper's Verdict channel cancel all added with cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said only 'Wall-pin stun. Dodge it.'
audit.why: Steadfast Presence at 20s rank 1 is the longest lane cooldown here and the one that gates every Searing Charge; it was never tracked.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries Heroic Charge 475/14s with its wall condition and Steadfast Presence 20s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad, and the page used male pronouns for Poppy in breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave and breakdown.feeding.
audit.why: 'If he snowballs' about Poppy reads as untouched template text.
audit.corrected: The two duplicated rules now carry distinct mechanics; pronouns fixed in the strings edited.

notes: The standout finding: Ornn's own magma pillar is the wall Heroic Charge needs. 'If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned' plus 'a magma pillar forms at the end location' means a pillar dropped behind Ornn arms Poppy's stun. The page previously said 'Q the pillar behind Poppy' with no warning about which side; placement is now specified in four strings. Also corrected: Hammer Shock was described as a knockup twice — it is a slow zone that explodes after a delay, no displacement anywhere in its text. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Steadfast Presence stops the RECAST of Call of the Forge God (Ornn's R recast is flagged as a dash into the elemental, so the ult may be partly deniable even though the elemental itself is not a dash) — the page's claim that 'her W only blocks your E, not the ult' is now phrased around the elemental only. QUESTION FOR THE USER, listed in questionsForUser. Also not asserted: whether Bellows Breath alone cancels Keeper's Verdict (the missing-interactions file claims it does, but Brittle is not stated as crowd control in Riot's text, so I credited the E and R knockups instead).
